description: Sample portfolio for manually testing the Portfolio Analysis Agent and the Streamlit Portfolio tab. Values are illustrative, not real financial data.
notes: Deliberately mixes individual stocks (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, TSLA) with a broad-market ETF (VOO) so a portfolio analysis run against this set has something meaningful to say about diversification.
TSLA is included at a relatively small share count so it's useful for testing concentration-risk commentary without dominating the whole portfolio.
To use: paste these holdings into the Streamlit app's Portfolio tab one at a time, or load this file directly in a test/demo script via json.load().
